ad_library.summary: Bhanu PV Solar is running 1 active Telugu Meta ad (Facebook), started 13 October 2026, promoting rooftop solar with government subsidy, EMI options and a free site visit. The click lands on an fb.me link inside Facebook, so the spend never reaches bhanupvsolar.com. The advertiser is a national EPC - 50,000+ projects, 90+ MW, #1 Gujarat / #2 India rooftop EPC, 11 states including Telangana - with a Hyderabad office. No Google Ads advertiser record was checked for this report - that requires the full pipeline.

funnel.meaning: Every click opens a Facebook surface, not bhanupvsolar.com. For a national brand with 50,000+ projects, that means the Hyderabad campaign builds no owned audience: no pixel, no retargeting pool, no page to test a Hyderabad-specific offer on.

findings: The one live ad points to an fb.me link inside Facebook - the click never lands on bhanupvsolar.com, so no pixel, no retargeting pool, no testable landing page.

The site carries the scale proof the ad needs - 50,000+ projects, 90+ MW, #1 Gujarat / #2 India rooftop EPC, 11 states, 500+ dealers, MNRE-approved components - and none of the paid traffic ever sees it.

Three contact routes are published (toll-free 1800 889 2353, the Hyderabad office number +91 70132 10502 and info@bhanupvsolar.in) while the ad click dead-ends inside Facebook before reaching any of them.
1 ad, live since 13 Oct, all cold traffic. There is no retargeting ad behind it and no second creative to test the subsidy angle against the EMI angle.
The free-site-visit CTA matches the site's own offer - the journey breaks only at the last step, where the click leaves for fb.me.
next_steps: Move the click onto a page you own

Point the ad at a dedicated Hyderabad landing page carrying the same subsidy + EMI + free site visit offer, the local Laxmiguda office details, an enquiry form and the Meta Pixel - so every click is measurable and retargetable.
One pixel plus the Conversions API gives you the audience of everyone who clicked but did not enquire - usually 10-20x the people who fill a form.
Give the national scale a local page
A Hyderabad section (office address, local installs, Telangana service promise) turns the 50,000+ projects proof into a reason to enquire locally.
Add a second creative for the EMI angle
The EMI promise is a separate buying trigger from the subsidy promise - a second creative plus its own landing section tells you which one converts.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
